title: For people building AI trading agents, how are you handling multiple venues
author: ovo_quant
selftext:
I’ve been experimenting with a small trading agent and started with one venue, but once I looked at adding another, the amount of separate plumbing for market data, orders, fills, and positions got messy pretty quickly.  
Are you maintaining separate integrations for market data, orders, fills and positions on each platform, or using some kind of common layer.  
  
Curious what people actually do in practice once they move beyond one broker/exchange.
